sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

As the game progresses, the difficulty level increases, and you'll need to rely on your quick reflexes to take down the zombies before they overwhelm you. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with a few key mechanics that make all the difference in the world.

Firstly, the game features a variety of guns and upgrades that you can use to take down the zombies. These range from simple pistols to more complex sniper rifles, and each has its own unique strengths and weaknesses. Upgrading your arsenal is crucial, as it allows you to take on the tougher zombies and hold out for longer.

Secondly, the game features a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can be used to give you an edge in battle. These range from health packs to temporary shields, and can be used to turn the tide of battle in your favor. However, these power-ups are scarce, so you'll need to use them wisely.

Finally, the game features a variety of zombies with unique strengths and weaknesses. Some are slow-moving but take a lot of damage, while others are fast-moving but have little health. Learning to take down these different types of zombies is crucial to surviving the game.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Zombie Arena are simple yet addictive, and make for a thrilling experience that's not to be missed. With its simple controls and challenging gameplay, this game is perfect for players of all skill levels.
